cohort: 1,346,889 women delivering singleton births at ≥20 weeks' gestation in California from 2007 through 2011
finding: Women age ≥50 years with a singleton pregnancy experience significantly higher rates of cesarean delivery compared to non-AMA women, however the majority of those who undergo a trial of labor will have a vaginal delivery.
mod_finding: Neither a trial of labor nor a prelabor cesarean delivery is significantly associated with maternal or neonatal morbidity.
